question.prompt: A can complete a job alone in 6 days, and B can complete it alone in 12 days. How many days will they need working together? (Unit: days)

solutions.explanation: Let the time needed working together be \(x\) days, and take the total amount of work as 1. Then \((1/6+1/12)x=1\), or \((1/4)x=1\), so \(x=4\).
solutions.title: Unit-work equation
